text:
maria: starting a staged canary for the new rate policy (rate_limit.v2) now — initial ramp 5% of traffic -> plan to 25% over 30m. Change summary: reduce per-client burst bucket from 100 tokens -> 30 tokens, keep steady qps limits. monitoring: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/rl-policies

aj: thanks — where's the canary list? dashboards to watch? can you post the rollout id?

maria: canary group = tag:canary-a. rollout id rl-20260315-09. dashboards: rl-policies -> error-429, per-key 429, gateway-queue-depth. also watch p50/p95 latency. deploy-bot posted deployment details.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started rl-20260315-09 -> rate_limit.v2 -> targets: tag:canary-a (5%)

linda: seeing first support hits — a customer (acct:brightpay) reported repeated 429s ~3 mins after rollout start. ticket #SUP-4532. logs attached: 
```
[2026-03-15T09:12:44Z] api_key=sk_live_brightpay status=429 route=/v1/complete burst_left=0 token_bucket_capacity=30
[2026-03-15T09:12:45Z] api_key=sk_live_brightpay status=429 retries=2
```

kevin: can you paste minimal repro? probably a bursty client hitting single-token buckets. try this: 
```
for i in {1..50}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/complete -d '{"prompt":"test"}' &
 done; wait
```

aj: running quick query to find top affected keys now. SQL to reproduce (run on analytics): 
```
SELECT api_key, count(*) as errors FROM requests
WHERE status=429 AND created_at > now() - interval '10 minutes'
GROUP BY api_key ORDER BY errors DESC LIMIT 50;
```

aj: results (top 3): sk_live_brightpay (482 errors), sk_live_quikchat (210), sk_test_inhouse (60). most of these are high-burst integrations (websocket frontends + aggressive reconnects).

maria: ok — action: pause the ramp to 5% and investigate. do NOT rollback yet unless errors keep rising. can we add temp override for these keys?

kevin: we have a per-key override feature in config: rate_limit.overrides[<api_key>].increase_burst=100. I can patch the canary config for the listed keys. applying override to brightpay and quikchat now.

kevin: applying: 
```
redwood config set rate_limit.v2.overrides.sk_live_brightpay.burst=100 --env=canary
redwood config set rate_limit.v2.overrides.sk_live_quikchat.burst=100 --env=canary
```

deploy-bot: Config update applied to canary environment (change-id cfg-9876)

aj: monitoring 429s — brightpay 429s dropped from 482 -> 12 in last 5m. quikchat down to 8. overall canary 429 rate dropped 78%. p95 latency unchanged.

linda: Support will notify affected customers that we made a temporary exception and will follow up with a PR to update best-practices.

maria: good. plan next: keep canary at 5% for another 30m, extend overrides until we have a longer-term mitigation (either increase default burst window or update SDK guidance). update runbook to require whitelist step for known high-burst partners during staged rollouts.

kevin: filing follow-up PR to increase default bucket to 50 tokens for v2 and add explicit rollout opt-in for partners that need higher bursts. I'll also add automated smoke tests that replay known burst patterns. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1291

aj: one more thing — alerts were noise-heavy. we should tune the 429 alert to be sensitive to delta% over baseline (absolute > 100 and delta > 50%) so small canaries don't trigger pagers. creating a ticket.

maria: agreed — aj, assign to eng-sre. linda, please follow up with the customers on ticket SUP-4532 and confirm they see normal traffic. kevin, keep the overrides until PR merges. I'll hold the ramp.

api-gateway-bot: Canary traffic at 5% steady. current canary error rate 429: 0.9% (down from 4.6% immediately after rollout).

linda: confirmed with brightpay — they see errors stopped after override. will close SUP-4532 after final confirmation.

maria: note to self: add a 'canary whitelist' step to the rollout checklist and require a 15m quiescent period before increasing canary % beyond 5%. will update docs. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
